channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: TRE-SP multa Lula por propaganda antecipada e manda tirar vídeo do ar
item.description: The São Paulo Electoral Court fined President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva R$15,000 for premature electioneering after he stated in an official event, streamed on his YouTube channel, that the public could 'give their vote to the two' Simone Tebet and Marina Silva. The judge ruled the phrase, despite the 'one day' qualifier, constituted an explicit call for votes before the official campaign period. Tebet and Silva were cleared due to lack of evidence they knew or participated in the speech's preparation.

item.title: O candidato que pode ameaçar Flávio Bolsonaro na direita, segundo cientista político
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party candidate, appears with 7.8% in voting intentions, surpassing Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema, and stands out as a potential threat to Flávio Bolsonaro on the right. According to political scientist Elias Tavares, his growth indicates he is no longer a virtual candidacy and could attract voters dissatisfied with bolsonarism, fragmenting the right-wing vote and benefiting Lula.

item.title: STF questiona uso de 'deepfake' de Jair Bolsonaro em campanha presidencial de Flávio
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Court (STF) has requested explanations from former President Jair Bolsonaro regarding an AI-generated deepfake video in which a digital replica of him appears to endorse the presidential candidacy of his eldest son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, for the October elections. The use of deepfake technology in political campaigns raises concerns about misinformation and public opinion manipulation.

item.title: Aliado de Cunha, articulador de Zema e histórico de rompimentos: quem é Marcelo Aro, favorito para palanque de Flávio em MG
item.description: Marcelo Aro, former federal deputy and political operative linked to Eduardo Cunha and Romeu Zema, is emerging as the leading candidate to head Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket in Minas Gerais for 2026, following fallouts with allies like Alexandre Kalil and being passed over for Zema's vice-presidential slot. His career includes supporting Dilma Rousseff's impeachment, leading the FMF, and serving in Zema's Civil House before resigning to pursue a majoritarian candidacy.

item.title: Governo Lula anuncia plano de R$ 1,3 bi para prevenção do El Niño
item.description: The Lula government announced a R$1.335 billion plan to prevent and mitigate the impacts of El Niño in 2026, focusing on grain purchases, wildfire suppression, and food basket distribution. The initiative involves 23 ministries and six agencies, featuring a newly created El Niño Situation Room structured around four pillars: data unification, risk mapping, anticipatory action, and protection of vulnerable populations. Priority is given to high-risk areas in the North and Central-West, including Pará, Mato Grosso and Tocantins.

item.title: Maioria desaprova decisão de Moraes que impediu Flávio de visitar o pai, aponta Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on July 23 reveals that a majority of Brazilians disapprove of Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes' decision to prohibit Senator Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting former President Jair Bolsonaro for a 90-day period. The ruling was deemed inappropriate by most respondents, indicating public perception that the measure was excessive or politically motivated.

item.title: Se El Niño for grave, estamos preparados; se não for, valeu a intenção, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that Brazil is prepared to face the effects of a severe El Niño in the second half of 2024, citing investments in disaster prevention and response. If the phenomenon does not intensify, he said it was still 'worth the intention,' emphasizing the government's proactive stance. The remarks were made in Brasília on March 29 during a press briefing on climate adaptation policies.

item.title: Caiado critica Milei e IA de Bolsonaro em convenção de Flávio
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Javier Milei's participation in the PL convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy, as well as the use of an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro at the event, stating the absence of proposals and the presence of an 'avatar' and an Argentine made the event 'crude'. He also argued that political focus is shifting to external issues, such as tensions with the United States involving Argentina, rather than national debates.

item.title: “Não há chance de rompimento” com o Brasil, diz chanceler argentino
item.description: Argentine Foreign Minister Pablo Quirno stated there is no risk of a diplomatic rupture with Brazil, despite President Javier Milei's insults toward Lula during a PL event in São Paulo. He framed the incident as part of a broader history of political and ideological differences between the two nations and defended Milei's participation as personal support for the Bolsonaro family, not an institutional act. Argentina will not respond to Lula or his ministers' statements.

item.title: Proximidade de novo ministro das Relações Exteriores do Peru com EUA preocupa Brasil
item.description: The appointment of Carlos Espá, a former journalist and Peruvian presidential candidate, as Peru’s new Foreign Minister by the conservative government of Keiko Fujimori, has raised concerns in the Lula administration due to his perceived closeness to the United States. Brazil fears this alignment could undermine regional coordination and South American interests in areas such as trade integration and an independent foreign policy.

item.title: Ministério recomenda veto a trechos de projeto que cria piso mínimo do frete para caminhoneiros
item.description: The Ministry of Transport recommended a partial veto to the Civil House on the Bill of Conversion concerning the minimum freight floor for truckers, proposing the removal of six provisions, including amnesty for fines related to post-2022 election roadblocks and changes to the CLT, ANTT, and CTB. Senate government leader Randolfe Rodrigues had already anticipated that Lula would veto the amnesty clause. The justification states the provisions are unrelated to the freight floor and could undermine ANTT’s regulatory authority.

item.title: Caiado diz que Flávio Bolsonaro perdeu para argentino e avatar na convenção do PL: ‘Nível rasteiro’
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD presidential pre-candidate, criticized the PL convention featuring Flávio Bolsonaro as 'low-level', claiming it focused on international attacks and AI-generated imagery of Jair Bolsonaro instead of presenting the candidate's actual views. He and his running mate Gilberto Kassab said the event abandoned societal expectations, turning politics into spectacle. Caiado also opposed penalizing AI, advocating for criminalizing misuse of technology while upholding copyright protections.

item.title: Governador da Bahia reage à declaração de Caiado sobre 'alforriar' estado caso seja eleito: 'Ofensivo e infeliz'
item.description: Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) condemned presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado’s (PSD) use of the term 'alforriar' to describe liberating Bahians, calling it offensive and hurtful, especially given his Afro-Indigenous heritage. Jerônimo emphasized Bahia’s history of resisting slavery and authoritarianism, and linked Caiado and ACM Neto to Bolsonarism despite their current critiques. A Genial/Quaest poll shows a technical tie between Jerônimo and ACM Neto in the race for Bahia’s governorship.

item.title: Petista é confrontado por assentados após chamar Bolsonaro de “canalha”
item.description: State deputy Zeca do PT from Mato Grosso do Sul was confronted by settlers from the Assentamento Mutum in Ribas do Rio Prado after calling former president Jair Bolsonaro a 'scoundrel' during a speech. Protesters reacted with outrage, challenging his harsh language and defending Bolsonaro, who is imprisoned following Lava Jato convictions. The incident underscores Brazil's deep political polarization and tensions between Lula and Bolsonaro supporters in rural areas.

item.title: Sabemos separar as coisas, diz Marina Silva sobre ofensas de Milei
item.description: Marina Silva criticized Javier Milei's insults against Lula and the Brazilian Presidency, stating they do not affect Brazil-Argentina relations because 'we know how to separate things'. Milei's remarks, made at the PL convention in São Paulo, included calling Alexandre de Moraes 'bald trash' and coining the term 'risk Lula', escalating diplomatic tensions that have existed since his inauguration in December 2023.

item.title: Como a campanha de Tarcísio reagiu aos novos números da disputa em São Paulo
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas leads voting intentions in São Paulo with advantages of 13 and 15 points over Fernando Haddad, according to surveys by Instituto Paraná Pesquisas and Genial/Quaest. His campaign attributes the lead to public recognition of his administration’s achievements and plans to intensify pre-campaign activities starting in August, traveling across the state to listen to voters and present proposals.

item.title: Defesa deve dizer ao STF que Bolsonaro não sabia do vídeo com IA exibido pela campanha de Flávio
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense is set to inform the STF that the former president had no prior knowledge of the AI-generated video used at the PL convention to support his son Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy, aired on March 25. Minister Alexandre de Moraes asked whether Bolsonaro authorized the video, which could constitute a violation of his political speech ban and lead to the reversal of his house arrest. The response is due by March 30 and may harm Flávio Bolsonaro, as unauthorized AI use in campaigns may result in fines and content removal under electoral law.

item.title: Governo anuncia pacote de R$ 1,3 bilhão para enfrentar efeitos do El Niño previsto para 2026/2027
item.description: The federal government announced a R$1.3 billion package to address the impacts of a very strong El Niño event expected between 2026 and 2027, focusing on public food stockpiles, wildfire suppression, climate monitoring, and health system reinforcement. The allocation includes R$850 million for purchasing 310,000 tons of rice and 180,000 tons of maize, alongside the establishment of an El Niño Situation Room involving 24 federal ministries to coordinate with states and municipalities.

item.title: Ciência busca escapar do teto enquanto Durigan promete apertá-lo
item.description: The Lula administration seeks to shield science and technology spending from the fiscal arcabouço by classifying it as 'strategic capital investment' to avoid blocks and contingencies, while the Finance Ministry, led by Dario Durigan, proposes cutting real public spending growth from 2.5% to between 1.5% and 2%, saving R$12–25 billion annually from 2027. The proposal lacks detail on which expenses would be covered and whether protection would extend to spending limits or the primary surplus target, with an MCTI-created group having 120 days to draft the PACTI 2027–2031, notably excluding formal representatives from Finance and Planning.

item.title: Caiado diz que Flávio “perdeu para um avatar” em convenção do PL
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) and Gilberto Kassab (PSD) criticized the PL's national convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy, saying the event abandoned national policy proposals and focused solely on political attacks and defending an 'avatar' — a reference to a symbolic or virtual figure used in the campaign.

item.title: Caiado critica convenção do PL e diz que Flávio perdeu para Milei e IA de Bolsonaro
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized the PL convention, stating that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) "lost to an Argentine and an avatar," referring to the presence of Argentine President Javier Milei and the use of an AI-generated video of former President Jair Bolsonaro during the event.

item.title: Caiado chama regulação das Big Techs de retrógrada e defende código aberto
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized the Lula government's proposal to regulate Big Tech platforms and AI, calling it retrograde and harmful to Brazil's competitiveness. He advocated for open-source code as an alternative during an event alongside PSD president Gilberto Kassab. The remarks were made on May 29 and reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: Caiado e Kassab criticam participação de Milei e uso de IA com Bolsonaro em convenção de Flávio
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized the PL convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy, saying the event was dominated by Argentine President Javier Milei and an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro, leaving the candidate sidelined and without proposals. He described the tone as 'low' and accused the ticket of avoiding national debate by focusing on international attacks. Gilberto Kassab, PSD president and Caiado's running mate, agreed, stating the convention failed to present Brazilian priorities and instead engaged in a low-level confrontation with the current government.

item.title: TRE-SP multa Lula em R$ 15 mil por propaganda antecipada após pedir para 'dar votos' para Marina e Tebet
item.description: The Regional Electoral Court of São Paulo (TRE-SP) fined President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva R$15,000 for premature campaigning after he told motorcyclists at a government-broadcast event to 'give your vote to the two,' referring to Senate candidates Marina Silva and Simone Tebet. The court ruled the statement constituted an explicit request for electoral support before the official campaign period, dismissing the defense's claim that 'one day' made the remark non-specific. The fine was based on the judgment that the phrase had clear electoral content, prohibited under electoral law.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula faz reunião ministerial para discutir Super El Niño
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva held a ministerial meeting at the Palácio do Planalto to align federal government actions ahead of the anticipated impacts of Super El Niño. The meeting discussed prevention, response, and coordination measures among federal agencies, including the operation of the Interministerial Situation Room, strengthening Civil Defense, investments in drainage and containment, wildfire prevention, and monitoring logistics in the North region, particularly Amazon river levels for agricultural production transport.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: Flávio também vai fugir dos debates?
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) campaign announced it will not participate in presidential debates if President Lula also chooses to skip them. The decision was reported on the Meio-Dia em Brasília program on Wednesday, the 29th, reflecting a strategy to avoid direct confrontations. Additionally, Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has requested explanations regarding the campaign’s conduct, though the specifics were not detailed in the article.

item.title: Flávio só vai participar de debates se Lula aparecer
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a pre-candidate for president, announced he will only participate in first-round debates if they include a direct confrontation with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). The decision was made with his campaign team and confirmed by Bolsonarist sources to O Antagonista and O Globo. The condition reflects a strategy to avoid debates with other candidates and focus exclusively on a showdown with Lula.

item.title: TSE reafirma mecanismos de segurança das urnas eletrônicas após críticas ao sistema eleitoral
item.description: The TSE reaffirmed the security of Brazil's electronic voting system, highlighting 30 years of operation since 1996 and rigorous audits before, during, and after elections. The court emphasized the public availability of the source code for inspection by authorized institutions from October 2025 to September 2026, involving the Senate, Brazilian Computing Society, CNC, and União Brasil. The Public Security Test, concluded in May 2026, found no vulnerabilities capable of compromising vote secrecy or altering election results.

item.title: CNT detalha plano de R$ 2 tri em infraestrutura a candidatos ao Planalto
item.description: The CNT released a strategic infrastructure plan worth R$ 2.03 trillion across 2,837 priority projects for presidential candidates, alongside warnings about the economic impacts of potential labor law changes, particularly reducing the workweek and ending the 6x1 schedule, which could raise annual labor costs by R$ 28.1 billion and eliminate 84,000 jobs. The document also calls for legal security, funding for energy transition, and action against transport insecurity, citing up to R$ 1 billion in annual losses from cargo theft and bus arson.

item.title: Bolsonaro dirá a Alexandre de Moraes que não sabia de vídeo de IA usado por Flávio
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro will tell Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes that he was unaware his son, Flávio Bolsonaro, would use an AI-generated video featuring his image and voice at the PL party convention. The statement comes amid investigations into disinformation and AI use in electoral campaigns. The incident occurred on July 29, 2026.

item.title: "Emenda Pix" não é o mesmo que "passar um Pix", diz Dino
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino of the STF emphasized that parliamentary amendments, or 'Pix amendments,' are not equivalent to sending money via Pix to a family member or local shop, as they involve public funds subject to traceability and constitutional responsibility. He ordered the government and Congress to submit, within 10 days, a responsibility matrix for the execution of these amendments to ensure transparency and prevent diversion schemes. The ruling reinforces that public money must follow constitutional rules, not be treated as discretionary personal transfers.

item.title: TSE rejeita pedido de observação das eleições feito por grupo sediado na Espanha
item.description: The TSE rejected the request by the Eurolat Global Democracy Forum, based in Spain, to observe the 2026 Brazilian elections, stating the entity does not meet the technical criteria for international electoral observation missions. The group, which presents itself as a civil society organization, lacks recognized institutional ties to universities, research centers, or international bodies, and uses a name similar to the Euro-Latin American Parliamentary Assembly. Two other requests, including one from Transparencia Electoral, remain under review.

item.title: Fernanda Bolsonaro, dentista, posta foto com Flávio durante consulta
item.description: Fernanda Bolsonaro, dentist and wife of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), posted a photo alongside the presidential candidate during a dental consultation on July 28, 2026, emphasizing the importance of preventive oral health care. Flávio reposted the image with an affectionate message, while Fernanda reiterated her support for her husband during the PL national convention, stating she is not a politician and attended solely to support him.

item.title: Dino determina que governo e Congresso especifiquem 'responsabilidade' de parlamentares sobre emendas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ruled that Congress and the federal government must define the responsibility of parliamentarians in the indication and execution of parliamentary amendments, including 'Pix' and bloc amendments, to address the imbalance between allocation power and accountability. President Lula and the Senate and Chamber presidents have until August 19 to submit data to the STF, followed by opinions from the AGU and PGR, with final review by the Full Court.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Vídeo de Jair Bolsonaro feito por IA pode gerar punição a ele ou a Flávio, diz Moraes
item.description: Justice Alexandre de Moraes has given Bolsonaro's defense 48 hours to confirm whether the former president consented to the AI-generated video shown at the PL convention. The answer will determine if Bolsonaro violated his house arrest or if Flávio Bolsonaro and the PL breached TSE rules on deepfakes. The PL argues the video is not a deepfake because it discloses its synthetic nature, while the PT claims it constitutes abuse of political and economic power.

item.title: AtlasIntel/Bloomberg: aprovação de Lula vai a 48% e desaprovação recua a 51%
item.description: President Lula's approval rose to 47.6% and disapproval fell to 51.2% in the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg survey, leaving a net negative of 3.7 points. Despite the improvement, qualified government evaluation worsened, with only 37.9% rating it as excellent or good and 49.3% as poor or terrible. Approval remains strongest among women, Northeasterners, college-educated voters, Catholics, and low-income groups, while disapproval is concentrated among evangelicals, Southerners, men, and those aged 25-44.

item.title: Soninha como antídoto contra as candidatas de Lula em SP
item.description: Soninha Francine, Senate candidate for São Paulo from the PSDB-Cidadania Federation, debuted in the Paraná Pesquisas poll as a potential antidote to the candidacies of Marina Silva (Rede) and Simone Tebet (PSB), both supported by President Lula. A former Municipal Secretary of Human Rights in São Paulo, she positions herself as a center-right alternative amid the rise of Lulist-backed candidates in the state.

item.title: Presidente sul-coreano visita sede de sindicato que Lula presidiu
item.description: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung visited the headquarters of the ABC Metalworkers' Union in São Bernardo do Campo, touring the room where Lula once led the union. The visit took place one day after his meeting with Lula at the Palácio do Planalto, where they discussed strengthening economic and commercial ties between Brazil, South Korea, and Mercosur. Lee emphasized the union's historical significance as a symbol of resistance and workers' rights struggles.

item.title: Dino intima Lula, Motta e Alcolumbre sobre destinação de emendas
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino ordered President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, House Speaker Hugo Motta, and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to submit within 10 days a detailed plan assigning responsibility for the allocation of parliamentary amendments, including identification of all agents involved in the spending cycle. He emphasized that public funds must follow constitutional budgetary rules and that lawmakers should be held accountable like executive officials, since they designate beneficiaries, purposes, amounts, and recipient entities but currently face no oversight or liability for misuse. The ruling stems from ADI 7.995 filed by Rede Sustentabilidade, seeking to equate parliamentarians’ liability with that of mayors and governors.

item.title: Moraes pede explicações sobre vídeo de Bolsonaro feito por IA
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has given Jair Bolsonaro's defense 48 hours to clarify whether the former president authorized an AI-generated video presented at the PL convention, which may constitute a judicial order violation. The response will determine if Bolsonaro breached social media restrictions under house arrest or if Flávio Bolsonaro and the PL violated TSE rules on deepfakes, potentially leading to revocation of house arrest or electoral sanctions.

item.title: Janja “arrisca” falar coreano em evento com primeira-dama da Coreia do Sul
item.description: Brazilian First Lady Janja da Silva attended a cultural event in São Paulo alongside South Korean First Lady Kim Hye-kyung, where she attempted a Korean greeting during the pre-premiere of the 15th Korean Film Showcase. The event was part of parallel diplomatic activities accompanying South Korean President Lee Jae-myung’s state visit to Brazil, strengthening bilateral cultural ties, including a USP-Kafa partnership to train new filmmakers. Janja also referenced her prior visit to Brasília’s 'Festa de Luz' exhibition and noted the reciprocity of the warm reception received by the Brazilian delegation in South Korea in February 2026.

item.title: Cleitinho não disputará governo de Minas Gerais, diz presidente do Republicanos
item.description: Senator Cleitinho (REP-MG) will not run for governor of Minas Gerais in 2026, according to national Republicanos president Marcos Pereira. Despite his office contradicting the claim, the party states his absence from the state convention and lack of clear decision made the candidacy unfeasible. The Republicanos will now support Marcelo Aro (PP) for Senate on Governor Mateus Simões’ (PSD) ticket, while the PL had been awaiting his stance to back Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential bid.

item.title: Dino defende ampliar responsabilidade de parlamentares sobre emendas e dá 10 dias para governo e Congresso criarem proposta
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino has ordered the Presidency and congressional leadership to submit, within 10 days, a proposal for a 'responsibility matrix' regarding parliamentary amendments, including personal accountability for lawmakers who authorize them. The ruling, issued in a case challenging the constitutionality of imposed amendments, stresses that parliamentarians cannot invoke immunity to avoid oversight when their actions directly influence public fund allocation. Dino cited the 2025 budget figures for individual (R$26.6bn), bloc (R$11.2bn), and committee (R$12.1bn) amendments, and referenced TCU, MP, and civil society studies showing recurrent misappropriation, inefficiency, and lack of traceability.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja como está a corrida presidencial em 7 estados, segundo a Quaest
item.description: Lula leads the presidential race in Bahia and Pernambuco, while Flávio Bolsonaro is ahead in Paraná. In Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, and São Paulo, the race is technically tied between Lula and Bolsonaro, with Romeu Zema standing out in Minas Gerais at 12%. The undecided voter percentage ranges from 8% to 14% across the surveyed states.

item.title: Durigan afirma que governo federal terminará o ano com déficit zero
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan stated the federal government will end 2026 with a zero deficit and potential surplus, citing R$17.5 billion in public budget cuts despite challenges like the Iran war, El Niño, and U.S. tariffs. He argued the government is setting a fiscal responsibility example in an election year, contrasting with previous 'fake' budgets.

item.title: Caiado questiona sigilo de 100 anos sobre visitas na PF
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized the 100-year secrecy imposed on visitor records for businessman Daniel Vorcaro while in federal police custody, accusing the Lula government of hiding information. He called the measure a lack of transparency and a possible sign of favoritism.

item.title: Datafolha: 59% reprovam Moraes por vetar visita de Flávio a Bolsonaro
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows 59% of Brazilian voters disapprove of Justice Alexandre de Moraes' decision to ban Senator Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting former President Jair Bolsonaro, while 36% approve. The same poll reveals 59% support keeping Jair Bolsonaro under house arrest and 62% believe he should not be allowed to use social media while incarcerated.

item.title: Uso de IA para burlar a Justiça expõe a fragilidade de Flávio
item.description: The use of an AI-generated video featuring Jair Bolsonaro's image and voice at the PL convention to support Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy violated TSE resolutions and an STF house arrest order, constituting a double illegality. Flávio's defense, relying on absurd comparisons to Lula's paper masks and old PT slogans, was dismissed as legally unfounded. The incident damaged Flávio's image, turning the convention into a spectacle of illegality that overshadowed any substantive policy discussion.

item.title: Em nova ofensiva contra Flávio, PT aciona TSE por vídeo de IA em que senador pilota caça militar ao lado de Milei
item.description: The PT filed a complaint with the TSE against Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) over an AI-generated video showing him piloting a military jet alongside Javier Milei, which the party claims constitutes premature propaganda and illegal deepfake use. The PT requests the video’s removal, a R$ 90,000 fine, and an order to prevent similar content, arguing the video falsely links the PT to the Comando Vermelho and misuses the images of Lula and Janja.

item.title: Republicanos não quer mais candidatura de Cleitinho: "Perdeu o timing"
item.description: Senator Cleitinho (Republicanos/MG) began signaling his intention to run for governor of Minas Gerais after months of uncertainty, but his party has withdrawn support, saying he 'missed the timing'. The Republicanos now backs Marcelo Aro (PP) as their candidate, in alliance with Flávio Bolsonaro's PL, while Cleitinho retains ally support and may persist in the race despite his personal tragedy.
